entities.name: SERVICE REJECT message
entities.description: NAS message that can trigger wireline access service area restrictions when received with 5GMM cause #28.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message that can trigger wireline access service area restrictions when received with 5GMM cause #28.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
entities.description: Registration accept message that can trigger wireline access service area restrictions when received with PDU session reactivation result error cause IE containing 5GMM cause #28.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #28
entities.description: Restricted service area cause code that triggers enforcement of wireline access service area restrictions.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
entities.description: State entered when wireline access service area restrictions are enforced, restricting most procedures except for emergency services and high priority access.

entities.name: Wireline access service area restrictions enforcement
entities.description: Behavior where 5G-RG or W-AGF restricts registration, service request, and 5GSM procedures over wireline access except for emergency services and high priority access.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for mobility and periodic registration update that is restricted in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure that is restricted in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state except for emergency services fallback and high priority access.

entities.name: 5GSM procedure
entities.description: 5G session management procedures that are restricted in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state except for emergency services and high priority access.

entities.name: Emergency services
entities.description: Exception condition that allows restricted procedures to be performed in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state.

entities.name: High priority access
entities.description: Exception condition that allows restricted procedures to be performed in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state.

relations.description: SERVICE REJECT message contains 5GMM cause #28 IE that triggers restrictions.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message contains 5GMM cause #28 IE that triggers restrictions.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains PDU session reactivation result error cause IE with 5GMM cause #28 that triggers restrictions.
Receipt of 5GMM cause #28 establishes enforcement of wireline access service area restrictions.
Enforcement of wireline access service area restrictions requires entering 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state.
Registration procedure is restricted in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state.
Service request procedure is restricted in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE state.
Emergency services condition allows registration procedure in restricted state.
High priority access condition allows registration procedure in restricted state.
Emergency services condition allows service request procedure in restricted state.
High priority access condition allows service request procedure in restricted state.
Emergency services condition allows 5GSM procedures in restricted state.
High priority access condition allows 5GSM procedures in restricted state.
